bugs.description: Sign of daysBack flipped: startOfDayMs now adds daysBack instead of subtracting it, so 'N days back' walks into the future instead of the past. Corrupts every caller that reconstructs a day boundary (readTrailHistory, etc.).
Speed-based segment-cut threshold raised 10x (40 -> 400), silently disabling the GPS-teleport/speed-jump detection that is supposed to split a trail into separate segments.
Round-trip mileage is no longer doubled (roundTrip = miles instead of miles * 2), so pay-per-mile is overestimated by roughly 2x and offers are misclassified as better pay than they actually are.
speechRecognizer is nulled out without calling destroy() first, leaking the underlying SpeechRecognizer system resource/mic binding every time the Activity is destroyed.

Result of Location.distanceBetween (already meters) is divided by 1000 as if converting to kilometers, but the function is named/used as distanceMeters everywhere (segment cut thresholds, trimStationaryEnds drift thresholds), so every downstream distance comparison is now ~1000x too small.

injection.find:
Location.distanceBetween(a.lat, a.lng, b.lat, b.lng, r)
        return r[0].toDouble()
injection.replace_with:
Location.distanceBetween(a.lat, a.lng, b.lat, b.lng, r)
        return r[0].toDouble() / 1000

bugs.description: OfferQueue (a singleton object) now stores the raw Context passed into enqueue() instead of context.applicationContext. If an Activity context is ever passed in, the Activity can never be garbage-collected, a classic static-reference memory leak.

Comparison operator flipped (< became >): cleanup now deletes every trail file newer than the cutoff date (the recent data worth keeping) while leaving everything older than keepDays untouched -- the exact opposite of the intended retention policy.
Earth-radius constant swapped from miles (3958.8) to kilometers (6371.0) inside the haversine helper. Every distance the AI agent context reports as 'mi' is actually ~1.6x too large.

Per-item penalty multiplier inflated 10x (0.05 -> 0.5) in scoreOffer. Offers with >5 items are penalized ~10x too heavily on pay-per-mile, so good multi-item offers get mislabeled as 'low pay'/'very low pay'.

injection.find: val itemPenalty = if (itemCount != null && itemCount > 5) (itemCount - 5) * 0.05 else 0.0
injection.replace_with: val itemPenalty = if (itemCount != null && itemCount > 5) (itemCount - 5) * 0.5 else 0.0
